lines.text: Many learners say: I am older than him two years.
Better: I am two years older than him.
Three years older! My sister is three years older than me.

data.wrong: I am older than him two years.
data.right: I am two years older than him.

native.hook: 差几岁要放在 older 前面！
native.tip: 中文说“比他大两岁”，差距放在最后。英语要把 two years 放在 older 前面。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “I am older than him two years.”😅 英语要把 two years 放在 older 前面，不能放在最后：“I am two years older than him.”跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“I am two years older than him.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Chinese puts the gap last, but English puts it before older.
en.caption: Do you say “I am older than him two years.” 😅 English puts the gap before older, not at the end: “I am two years older than him.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
